source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 3Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (9 months to 30 September 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Phillip Life Assurance. No 2Q2025 statement was supplied, so there is no previous-quarter extraction to compare with. Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; printed folio + 14 = file page). Units differ: the SCI (three months p.8, nine months p.10) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision: separate statements); the subsidiary's share of profit (equity method) is included in other income, as in FY2025 and 1Q2025. Note 6 nine months 2568 (columns non-PAA 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / total): revenue and expenses p.57, reinsurance p.58; incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward (note 7.1.1, reconciliation by measurement component, ณ วันที่ 30 กันยายน 2568) p.63-64; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business p.67; totals used (the onerous column shows a CSM of 12,777). RA release uses note 6 (5,491), equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 September 2568 (p.8).
